newsitem.title: USA: Research Frontiers product gets U.S. nod.
newsitem.headline: Research Frontiers product gets U.S. nod.

text.p: Research Frontiers Inc said on Monday that the U.S. Transportation Department issued a formal interpretation that permits commercial use of self-dimmable rear-view mirrors using the company's suspended-particle device.

The department interpreted one of its safety regulations to allow mirrors incorporating the technology to be used in the United States, the company said. It estimated the current potential market at $100 million per year for these kind of mirrors.
Research's device would compete with electrochromic mirrors now used on many high-end car models, the company said.
